intended_object: An auxiliary presentation of the map H_n(f): H_n(X;ℤ) → H_n(Y;ℤ) on integral singular homology. It is obtained by moving through the homology of the cover-small chains for two-set open covers compatible with f. Inferred from the docstring and from the lemma `twoOpenMayerVietorisSpaceMap_eq`.
explanation: The body first applies the inverse of the canonical isomorphism `twoOpenSpaceHomologyIso` from ordinary to U,V-small homology. It then applies the homology map that f induces on the small chain complexes, and finally the canonical isomorphism back to ordinary homology. The library proves right after the definition (`twoOpenMayerVietorisSpaceMap_eq`) that this equals `HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (integralSingularChainMap f) n`, the usual induced map in homology. So the definition introduces no new mathematical notion. It is a technical presentation of H_n(f) through the small-chains model, used to prove that the Mayer–Vietoris sequence is natural. The covers and their hypotheses are bookkeeping that the value does not depend on. Its docstring also describes it as a conjugation device. If it were read as "the induced map H_n(f)", it would be faithful, since the library proves exactly that equality.
